scheme_name: Tagore National Scholarship for Cultural Research
other_conditions: Applicant must have good academic credentials
At least one publication (book or research paper) in a reputed journal is required
Two years of research or teaching experience is required
Young artists and performers are also eligible to apply
Applicant must identify and select a nodal institution for the research project
The research project should primarily use the resources of the selected nodal institution
Applicant should be able to devote about two years to the project
benefits_summary: Monthly honorarium of ₹50,000 plus contingency grant, house‑rent allowance, settling allowance, travel support and infrastructural assistance for research.
